'''Corellstand''' was a manufacturing company that built the [[C-8 life support system/Legends|C-8 life support system]] which was installed as standard aboard [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighters]], including the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].<ref name="SWS" />
